title: Debtor Acceptance Criteria by Pack Size, Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs
content:
# Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs — Acceptance Specification for Submitted Debtors

This specification sets, for each pack size of the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs, the figures a submitted debt is measured against: the debt types accepted, whether business debtors are accepted, the smallest and largest balance, the youngest and oldest delinquency in days past due, the channels through which debtors may be submitted, and the wait before the same debt may be submitted again on a new unit after its series ends.

## Balance, age and debtor type

| Pack | Smallest balance (USD) | Largest balance (USD) | Days past due, at least | Days past due, beyond which not accepted | Business debtors accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 15.00 | 10000.00 | 30 | 365 | No — consumers only |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 15.00 | 15000.00 | 30 | 365 | No — consumers only |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 15.00 | 25000.00 | 30 | 365 | Yes |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 10.00 | 25000.00 | 21 | 540 | Yes |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 10.00 | 50000.00 | 21 | 540 | Yes |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 10.00 | 50000.00 | 15 | 730 | Yes |

## Debt types, channels and resubmission wait

| Pack | Accepted debt types | Submission channels | Resubmission wait after the series ends (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | medical, utility, telecom, retail installment, auto deficiency | email form, mail form, portal | 90 |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | medical, utility, telecom, retail installment, auto deficiency | email form, mail form, portal | 90 |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | medical, utility, telecom, retail installment, auto deficiency | portal, file transfer | 90 |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | medical, utility, telecom, retail installment, auto deficiency | portal, file transfer | 60 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | medical, utility, telecom, retail installment, auto deficiency | portal, file transfer | 60 |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | medical, utility, telecom, retail installment, auto deficiency | portal, file transfer | 60 |

## Notes

1. **Days past due** is how far past due the debt is. The first figure is the age a debt must reach before it is submitted; the second is the age beyond which a debt is not accepted.
2. **Business debtors accepted** states whether business debtors may be submitted as well as consumers. On the First Notice 50-Unit and 150-Unit Programs only consumer debtors may be submitted.
3. **Submission channels** lists every channel through which debtors may be submitted under that pack. The email form and the mail form are channels of the two smallest packs only; the file transfer is a channel of the four larger packs only; the portal is a channel of every pack.
4. **Resubmission wait** is the number of calendar days after a debtor's series ends before the same debt may be submitted again on a new unit.
5. The five accepted debt types are the same on every pack size.
